title: actaea rubra f. neglecta
intro: Actaea rubra f. neglecta, commonly known as Black Cohosh, is a flowering plant native to North America. It has been used for centuries in traditional medicine to treat a variety of health issues, with reported health benefits including relief from menopausal symptoms, menstrual cramps, and anxiety. The therapeutic actions of Black Cohosh are attributed to its ability to act as an antispasmodic, anti-inflammatory, and sedative, helping to calm the nervous system and alleviate pain. Bioactive constituents of Black Cohosh include triterpene glycosides, such as actein and 23-alpha-ethyl-25-hydroxy-26-deoxyactein, which have been shown to have neuroprotective and antioxidant properties.
